project_context.name: ALFA BLINDAGEM
project_context.description: Premium/luxury mobile-first website for an electronics armoring/protection company with an administrative panel.
project_context.aesthetic: Deep black, graphite, white, metallic gold, silver. Inspired by tech and premium car brands. Glassmorphism, soft shadows, micro-interactions.
project_context.slogan: Proteção que você sente. Qualidade que você vê.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-medium
hierarchy.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-zinc-500 font-bold

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Clash Display for all headings to give an award-worthy premium automotive/tech feel. Do not use generic sans like Inter. Manrope is strictly for body copy for crisp legibility.

visual_enhancers.gold_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] via-[#F3E5AB] to-[#D4AF37] bg-clip-text text-transparent
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlay on dark backgrounds to remove digital flatness.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal on load for the H1 using Framer Motion. Delay subtitle and CTA.
motion.scroll_animations: Elements fade and translate up slightly on scroll.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons have subtle scale-down on tap. Cards have gold border glow on hover.
motion.splash_screen: Cinematic loader with stylized shield + A logo animating on screen before revealing home.

hero_background.description: Abstract black and gold texture for splash/hero moments

service_iphone.description: Silver iPhone on dark aesthetic background

service_watch.description: Premium Apple Watch on dark background

texture_carbon.description: Carbon fiber texture for premium background sections

component_guidelines.landing_page: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for maximum layout creativity. Avoid standard Shadcn cards. Build bento grids with overlapping assets, 1px white/10 borders, and dark glass.
component_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Use standard Shadcn components (Cards, Tables, Forms, Dialogs). Keep it dense, high utility, with strict grid alignments.
component_guidelines.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for premium tech feel.
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px border. Background transparent or #D4AF37 for primary. Use subtle inner shadows for depth.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include `data-testid` in kebab-case. Example: `data-testid="budget-submit-button"`.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast over images using scrims (black/50 gradients). Do not use fully transparent header backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid deep blacks with subtle noise/texture.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Use real images provided in the guidelines, NEVER use placeholder image services.
